# ambientCG

> > A comprehensive library of public domain PBR materials, procedural textures, and HDRI environments for 3D rendering and game development.

ambientCG provides free, high-quality physically-based rendering (PBR) materials created with tools like Substance Designer. The library includes ground textures, wood floors, road surfaces, HDRIs, and various procedural materials available under Creative Commons CC0 license for commercial and personal use.

## Key Topics

- PBR materials
- Procedural textures
- 3D assets
- Substance Designer
- Ground textures
- HDRI environments
- Texture assets
- Procedural generation
- Public domain CC0
- Physically-based rendering
- 3D rendering materials
- Patreon support
- Coastal terrain
- Wood flooring
- Road surfaces

## Ground & Terrain Materials

- [Ground 095 A](https://ambientcg.com/a/Ground095A): Coastal terrain PBR ground texture with sand material for 3D assets
- [Ground 095 C](https://ambientcg.com/a/Ground095C): Mud surface procedural PBR ground texture for natural terrain rendering

## Architectural Materials

- [Wood Floor 065 B](https://ambientcg.com/a/WoodFloor065B): Vintage parquet wood flooring PBR texture for 3D environments

## Road & Infrastructure

- [Road Lines 035 C](https://ambientcg.com/a/RoadLines035C): Asphalt road texture with markings - procedural PBR material
- [Road Lines 029 B](https://ambientcg.com/a/RoadLines029B): Pavement markings asphalt texture for street infrastructure scenes

## Stone & Mineral Materials

- [Onyx Substance 001](https://ambientcg.com/a/OnyxSubstance001): Onyx marble stone texture created in Substance Designer for countertops

## HDRI Environments

- [Morning Sky HDRI 010 B](https://ambientcg.com/a/MorningSkyHDRI010B): Morning sunrise HDRI panorama for photorealistic 3D lighting

## Specialty Materials

- [Styrofoam 004](https://ambientcg.com/a/Styrofoam004): Styrofoam procedural texture asset for 3D rendering (Public Domain)
